body.name: Source-integral Möbius quadratic core
body.construction: Expose every incoming coefficient at a vertex of indegree at least two; on the other vertices factor rank-one residual relations in the integral source field, propagate rank-two relations by Möbius maps, record every genuine pole and every identically zero-over-zero interaction, and retain the resulting degree-at-most-two equations in at most \(2k\) exposed coefficients as \(\mathsf{Core}_{G,e}\).
